'''The House of Nuum''' was a bloodline of [[Near-Human]]s on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Smarteel]]. The line was rendered extinct after all its members were killed by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]].
